shortDescription: Bank Indonesia's newly approved governor on Tuesday said the central bank sees 2027 gross domestic product growth in a range of 5.2% to 6%.The bank also estimates the rupiah will trade at 17,300 to 17,800 per U.S. dollar in 2027, Governor Destry Damayanti said.

children: Bank Indonesia's newly approved governor on Tuesday said the central bank sees 2027 gross domestic product growth in a range of 5.2% to 6%.
The bank also estimates the rupiah will trade at 17,300 to 17,800 per U.S. dollar in 2027, Governor Destry Damayanti said.
